contract: Each emitted CIDS property maps to the signed source views that contribute its value. Fixed literals have an empty view list. Node-level sourceViews is the union of property-level views. No source row identifiers are added.
limitations: The field-to-view map does not identify exact source rows or retain content snapshots.
Published legacy output parity, live worker credentials/grants, OIDC, and MAN-CAP-038 acceptance remain open.
